title: Instructor in Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology
bio: Dr. Elizabeth Stanko Alpert is a lecturer on Oral Health Policy and Epidemiology at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM). She completed a general practice residency at the University of Washington, focusing on hospital dentistry in her first year and special care dentistry in her second year. She completed a year-long fellowship in Leadership Education in Neurodevelopmental and Related Disabilities and graduated with a Master of Public Health (MPH) in Health Policy from the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health. Alpert's research focuses on oral health equity and medical-dental integration.
